x: E.A.Smith put up his best performance of the season when finishing second in the London Business Houses 2 miles Championship at Hurlingham in the good time of 14m.28.4s.

In a ten miles invitation track walk at the White City on 31st of August Stan Vickers and Eric Hall Finished first and second in 74m.31.4s. and 76m9s. respectively. Also taking part were George Checkley who finished 15th in 83m.46s., and E.A.
1, K.J.Matthews(Royal Sutton Coldfield) 51m.39s; 2, E.W.Hall (Bel) 52.09; 6, N.Milsum(Bel)55.20; 8, E.A.Smith(Bel)55.43; 25, J.G.Coleman(Bel)59.58.

The same day (Jan.4th) E.A.Smith finished third in the London Business Houses 7 mile championship in 55.52. We also had a match versus Met.Police at "The Warren" Hayes and in a field of eighteen Stan Vickers was first home in 56.05.
…, beating Highgate, Polytechnic and many other fancied clubs in the process. A particularly fine effort was that of Ted Smith in finishing fourth and George Checkley sixth.…
